plans.note: No monetary cap, but § 9.7 Limitation of Liability (p0380) and § 9.6 Limited Recourse (p0378) exist; Servicer/Marketing Agent liable only for own willful misconduct, bad faith or gross negligence (p0283) with no recourse to personnel (p0284); Depositor mirror (p0243-p0244); no-liability-for-investments (p0191); arbitral panel barred from punitive/consequential damages (p0469). Worker to read §§ 9.6-9.7 fully and assess mutuality and culpability standard.

Counterparty indemnities present: Servicer indemnity (p0291), Marketing Agent indemnity (p0292), Proceedings procedure (p0293), survival (p0298). p0372 is our own defence-of-title covenant. Check whether trigger is limited to willful misconduct/bad faith/gross negligence and whether third-party IP claims and defence costs are covered.
Only 'court of competent jurisdiction' hits; no restriction on our businesses, products or fields of use. Likely not applicable.
'Exclusive' appears only as exclusive control of the Cap Collateral Account (p0387-p0388) and nonexclusive jurisdiction (p0427). No sole-supplier or purchasing exclusivity binding us.
No MFN or 'no less favorable terms' language located across several phrasings; only an unrelated 'pricing' reference in a Treasury definition. Treat as absent.
No non-solicit or no-hire covenant; 'employee' hits are indemnified-person and no-recourse references only.

No convenience exit either way: § 8.3 Termination (p0363); Servicer may not resign (§ 7.1, p0314); removal only on Servicer Termination Events (§ 7.2, p0317-p0318; limit at p0286). Optional Acquisition/Redemption exits at p0351 and p0358. Worker to assess acceptability in this securitization context.
No auto-renewal or renewal-term mechanic; term is event-based under § 8.3 (p0363). Confirm from p0363 before treating the rule as inapplicable.

§ 10.5 New York law (p0426), § 10.6 nonexclusive SDNY/NY jurisdiction (p0427), § 10.7 jury waiver (p0429) — accepted. Separate § 11.2 mediation/binding AAA arbitration track for reacquisition disputes (p0450-p0457, p0469); confirm it is US-seated and scope-limited.

§ 10.2 Assignment; Benefit of Agreement; Third-Party Beneficiary (TOC ref p0021 — operative text in sec-x), Depositor succession/assignment § 5.3 (p0249), Servicer merger/consolidation/succession § 7.6 (p0348). p0033-p0036 are asset conveyances, not contract assignment. Check consent standards and any change-of-control exit.

Data/records regime: Custodian holds Receivable Files (p0138-p0144) subject to Cellco privacy/data policies (p0146-p0147, p0338, p0346); Servicer records (p0131); file access (p0089); Issuer ownership of Receivables (p0115, p0057); PII scrubbing (p0446) and confidentiality (p0476). No IP assignment away from us; focus on unconditional access/return of our files.

No affirmative licence grant to us; only the negative covenant that Servicer need not license or assign its processes, models or servicing software to a Successor Servicer (p0346). Other hits are regulatory licences (p0234, p0259, p0272). Coordinate with TRANSITION to avoid double-flagging p0346.

Audit rights run in our favour: § 3.6 Review of Servicer's Records (p0131), § 6.7 assessment of compliance and accountants' attestation (p0303, p0309), Servicer bears its own expenses (p0135). No audit of us by the counterparty — do not flag; note access limits only.

No liquidated damages or penalty payable by us to the counterparty; Make-Whole Payments (p0351-p0362, p0398) are noteholder economics on optional redemption and Clean-Up Redemption is make-whole-free (p0351). Confirm no early-termination fee to Cellco.

Counterparty warranties: Servicer (p0257) and Marketing Agent (p0270) reps remade each Acquisition Date; Depositor reps (p0232); receivables eligibility reps surviving termination and non-waivable (p0062); without-recourse sale language at p0115. Assess duration and remedy (reacquisition/acquisition obligations).

No vendor insurance covenant; hits are Obligor insurance premiums billed to accounts (p0095) and FDIC deposit insurance in the Qualified Institution definition (p0903). Likely missing; weigh materiality given Parent Support Agreement credit support.
No minimum purchase, take-or-pay or volume restriction binding us; p0211 is the Marketing Agent's deposit obligation for Credit shortfalls, which benefits us.

§ 7.5 Transition of Servicing (p0342, p0347), Successor Servicer cooperation (p0157), delivery of Receivable Files (p0147), subject to privacy/data policies (p0338, p0346). Key issue: p0346 carve-out (no obligation to license software/processes or provide restricted materials) may undercut usable transition assistance.
